title: 第7章 供奉圣子双生武魂暗中佳人第8章 祖龙诀绝世风华女教皇帝薇央
slug: 双生神级武魂震惊妖帝老婆
content_zh:
;;
村民们惊为天人，不敢说话，苏玖儿悄无声息退到人群之中。
龙涛冲着洛凡尘兴奋道：“破碎空间！这可是了不得的大神通，一定是我神殿九十级以上的大人物，专程为你来的！！”
灰衣老者带着一位华服青年自空间裂缝走出。
那青年神情冷漠，双瞳赤金，似有火焰灼烧，神异非凡。
二者在注意到云村简陋的环境后，眉头皱起。
“分殿执事龙涛，拜见两位大人。”龙涛跪地施礼。
赤瞳青年淡声道：“吾，神殿圣子煌焱，这位是吾师四供奉。”
龙涛颅内轰的一声。
圣子煌焱！！
这可是传说中被誉为天下最强天才之一，未来教皇的准继承人啊。
至于供奉，何为供奉？
只有真正的强者才值得供奉，供世人瞻仰，侍奉，每一个供奉曾经都是神殿长老，真正站在神殿金字塔顶端的存在。
如今隐退供奉殿，专心修行。
神殿大供奉实力更是深不可测，乃是过去教皇退位，实力镇压一世，传说已经无限接近神明。
他整个人都麻了，万万没想到一则消息会炸出这么恐怖的存在过来，但想到洛凡尘的天赋，他的心里也就有底了。
煌焱道：“你传消息说这里出现了百年难遇的盖世天才？我和老师路过，便过来随便看看。”
龙涛用力点头，指着洛凡尘道：
“这便是那位天纵奇才，武魂觉醒异像惊人，前无古人，后也恐难有来者。”
“前无古人？呵，你倒是敢说。”

煌焱冷笑，甚至不屑多言，一个小小执事坐井观天，能有什么见识。
洛凡尘将对方神态看的真切。
这龙涛在外面难怪混的不好，这圣子明显便是倨傲之人，你说我前无古人，这不是打他脸么。
情商是个好东西啊，唉……
龙涛察觉到煌焱声音冷了下来，一时间茫然不解，神殿收获天骄难道不该高兴才是么，连忙解释道：
“禀告两位大人，这位武魂觉醒金光高达十丈，品级更是十彩十品，逆天神人之资啊。”
“不可能！”四供奉始终半眯着的眼睛睁开，透出精芒：“你敢为此话负责么。”
龙涛感受到莫大压力，汗水直流。
“大人明察，小人不敢有半句假话。”
四供奉笑了笑：“煌儿，你信么？”
“老师，我不信。”煌焱赤瞳看向洛凡尘，道：“小子，释放你的武魂。”
洛凡尘皱眉。
大人物专程找他，他很高兴，但对方说话的语气，他很不喜欢。
但来者明显实力强劲，他不想因为争一时之气给苏玖儿找麻烦。
“唰！”
洛凡尘心念一动，魂力激荡间，亢长龙吟响起，耀眼光芒在掌心浮现。
好强的龙威。
content_en:
;;
The villagers were so shocked that they didn't dare to speak. Su Jiuer quietly retreated into the crowd.
Long Tao said excitedly to Luo Fanchen: "Shattered Space! This is an incredible magical power. It must be a big shot above level 90 in our temple, coming here specially for you!!"
The old man in gray clothes walked out of the crack in space with a young man in colorful clothes.
The young man's expression was indifferent, his eyes were red gold, and they seemed to be burning with flames, which was extraordinary.
The two frowned after noticing the poor environment of Yun Village.
"Long Tao, the deacon of the branch hall, pays homage to the two adults." Long Tao knelt down and saluted.
The red-eyed young man said softly: "I, Huangyan, the Holy Son of the temple, this is the fourth worshiper of my master."
There was a bang in Long Tao's head.
Holy Son Huangyan! !
This man is said to be one of the strongest geniuses in the world and the prospective heir to the future Pope.
As for worship, what is worship?
Only the truly strong are worthy of worship, for the world to admire and serve. Every worshiper was once an elder of the temple, and truly stood at the top of the temple pyramid.
Now he retires to the worship hall and concentrates on practicing.
The strength of the temple's great enshrinement is even more unfathomable. In the past, the pope abdicated and his strength was suppressed for a lifetime. Legend has it that he is infinitely close to the gods.
His whole body was numb. He never expected that a piece of news would reveal such a terrifying existence, but when he thought of Luo Fanchen's talent, he felt reassured.
Huang Yan said: "Are you spreading the news that a unique genius that is rare to see in a century has appeared here? Teacher and I were passing by and came over to take a look."
Long Tao nodded vigorously, pointed at Luo Fanchen and said:
"This is the genius who has awakened his martial spirit. His vision is astonishing. It has never been seen before, and it is likely that there will be no one in the future."
"Unprecedented? Ha, you dare to say that."
Huang Yan sneered and didn't even bother to say anything. What insight could a little deacon have from sitting in a well and looking at the sky?
Luo Fanchen saw the other party's expression clearly.
No wonder Long Tao is not doing well outside. This Holy Son is obviously an arrogant person. If you say that I am unprecedented, isn't this a slap in his face?
Emotional intelligence is a good thing, alas...
Long Tao noticed that Huang Yan's voice had become colder, and he was confused for a moment. Shouldn't the temple be happy to have a genius? He quickly explained:
"I'm telling you, my lords, that the golden light of this martial soul's awakening is ten feet high, and its grade is ten colors and ten grades. He has the talent to defy the heavens."
"Impossible!" Si Zongfeng's eyes, which were always half-closed, opened with a bright light: "Do you dare to take responsibility for these words?"
Long Tao felt great pressure and sweatdropped.
"The adults are aware of this, and the villains dare not tell any lies."
The fourth priest smiled: "Huang'er, do you believe it?"
"Teacher, I don't believe it." Huang Yan's red eyes looked at Luo Fanchen and said, "Boy, release your martial spirit."
Luo Fanchen frowned.
He was very happy that the big shot came to see him specially, but he didn't like the tone of the other person's words.
But the person who came here was obviously very powerful, and he didn't want to cause trouble for Su Jiu'er just for a moment's gain.
"Uh-huh!"
Luo Fanchen's thoughts moved, and as his soul power surged, a long dragon roar sounded, and a dazzling light emerged in the palm of his hand.
What a powerful dragon.
